content: Is there a way to add new unicode shortcuts? For example, when I type "\tri" I want it to replace it with "◃"
There is, but I think it depends on which IDE you're using.

Snir Broshi said:

#Emacs > new unicode shortcuts

I was briefly excited at learning that someone had already asked this question about Emacs, my IDE of choice! The I realized that I was the one who asked that LOL

You can also consider the approach of inputing (and adding new) unicode shortcuts via your operating system rather than your IDE. Here is a page documenting a variety of non-IDE approaches:
https://lean.castedo.com/math-input/

For Vscode, you can either just define a custom shortcut locally or PR a new shortcut to the vscode-lean4 extension. See https://github.com/leanprover/vscode-lean4/blob/master/vscode-lean4/manual/manual.md#unicode-input for how to add a custom shortcut
